research.title: Evidence Sensitivity in Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
bullets: Designed controlled experiments varying passage relevance, evidence placement, and distractor content to examine answer grounding in retrieval-augmented question answering.
Analyzed answer correctness and supporting passage attribution, categorizing failures involving unsupported claims, conflicting evidence, and retrieval omissions.

research.title: Intent Classification and Confidence Calibration Under Domain Shift
bullets: Designed cross-domain evaluations comparing lexical and transformer classifiers, with controlled training subsets and held-out domains for intent recognition.
Analyzed calibration and abstention behavior across domain shifts, using reliability diagrams and error breakdowns to distinguish ambiguous requests from unfamiliar vocabulary.

publications.title: Confidence Calibration and Selective Prediction for Intent Classification Under Domain Shift
Lexical and Transformer Baselines for Cross-Domain Intent Recognition

work.title: Text Record Validation and Search Maintenance
bullets: Implemented validation checks for incoming text records, handling missing fields, inconsistent encodings, and duplicate submissions within an existing ingestion service.
Maintained search endpoint behavior and regression tests, investigating malformed queries and documenting reproducible cases for review during routine maintenance.

projects.title: Sequence Labeling for Entity Extraction
bullets: Implemented conditional random field and recurrent sequence tagging baselines for entity extraction, using consistent tokenization and shared training partitions.
Compared span-level precision and recall, examining boundary errors, rare entity categories, and sensitivity to lexical features through controlled ablations.

projects.title: Extractive Summarization with Relevance and Redundancy Controls
bullets: Implemented sentence ranking baselines using term weighting and graph centrality, with configurable redundancy penalties for selecting summary sentences.
Compared summaries using reference overlap and manual content checks, analyzing omitted information and repeated statements under matched summary length constraints.

projects.title: Sparse and Dense Retrieval for Document Search
bullets: Implemented sparse term matching and pretrained sentence embedding retrieval pipelines, keeping document segmentation and query preprocessing consistent across comparisons.
Evaluated ranking quality on held-out queries and inspected disagreements, separating failures involving exact terminology, paraphrases, and context-dependent query meanings.
